blocks.text: Россия Russia covers more than 6.5 million square miles or, roughly speaking, an area more than twice the size of the United States. The Ural Mountains divide the country into a European (western) half and an Asian (eastern) half. To the west, Russia shares borders with Belarus, Ukraine, Latvia and Estonia. Southern Russia extends to the Caucasus Mountains, which form the frontier with Georgia and Azerbaijan. In the east, that portion of Russia known as Сибирь Siberia stretches from the Arctic Ocean in the north to Kazakhstan, Mongolia and China in the south.

The southern portion of Russia is composed primarily of flat, treeless plains known as степь steppe. Siberia itself is comprised of a northern belt of permanently frozen, treeless plains тундра and, more southerly, vast evergreen forests тайга. Санкт-Петербург St. Petersburg, founded by Пётр Великий Peter the Great on the Gulf of Finland as a “window to the West”, has been nicknamed the “brain” of Russia, thanks to its regular, grid-like pattern of city planning. Москва Moscow, on the other hand, is often referred to as the “soul”, thanks to its more chaotic growth over the years and a more “Russian” look.

lines.ru: Россия. Москва — столица России. В России живут русские.
lines.en: Russia. Moscow is the capital of Russia. Russians live in Russia.

lines.ru: Украина. Киев — столица Украины. В Украине живут украинцы.
lines.en: Ukraine. Kiev is the capital of Ukraine. Ukrainians live in Ukraine.

lines.ru: Латвия. Рига — столица Латвии. В Латвии живут латыши.
lines.en: Latvia. Riga is the capital of Latvia. Latvians live in Latvia.

lines.ru: Литва. Вильнюс — столица Литвы. В Литве живут литовцы.
lines.en: Lithuania. Vilnius is the capital of Lithuania. Lithuanians live in Lithuania.

lines.ru: Эстония. Таллин — столица Эстонии. В Эстонии живут эстонцы.
lines.en: Estonia. Tallinn is the capital of Estonia. Estonians live in Estonia.

lines.ru: Молдавия. Кишинёв — столица Молдавии. В Молдавии живут молдаване.
lines.en: Moldavia. Kishinev is the capital of Moldavia. Moldavians live in Moldavia.

lines.ru: Белоруссия. Минск — столица Белоруссии. В Белоруссии живут белорусы.
lines.en: Belorussia. Minsk is the capital of Belorussia. Belorussians live in Belorussia.

lines.ru: Грузия. Тбилиси — столица Грузии. В Грузии живут грузины.
lines.en: Georgia. Tbilisi is the capital of Georgia. Georgians live in Georgia.

lines.ru: Армения. Ереван — столица Армении. В Армении живут армяне.
lines.en: Armenia. Yerevan is the capital of Armenia. Armenians live in Armenia.

lines.ru: Азербайджан. Баку — столица Азербайджана. В Азербайджане живут азербайджанцы.
lines.en: Azerbaijan. Baku is the capital of Azerbaijan. Azerbaijanis live in Azerbaijan.

lines.ru: Узбекистан. Ташкент — столица Узбекистана. В Узбекистане живут узбеки.
lines.en: Uzbekistan. Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan. Uzbeks live in Uzbekistan.

lines.ru: Казахстан. Алма-Ата — столица Казахстана. В Казахстане живут казахи.
lines.en: Kazakhstan. Alma-Ata is the capital of Kazakhstan. Kazakhs live in Kazakhstan.

lines.ru: Туркмения. Ашхабад — столица Туркмении. В Туркмении живут туркмены.
lines.en: Turkmenia. Ashkhabad is the capital of Turkmenia. Turkmens live in Turkmenia.

lines.ru: Таджикистан. Душанбе — столица Таджикистана. В Таджикистане живут таджики.
lines.en: Tajikistan. Dushanbe is the capital of Tajikistan. Tajiks live in Tajikistan.

lines.ru: Киргизия. Бишкек — столица Киргизии. В Киргизии живут киргизы.
lines.en: Kirghizia. Bishkek is the capital of Kirghizia. Kirghiz live in Kirghizia.

lines.en: I live, you live, they live
